name: AudioManager
description: FreeInk audio output: WAV (16-bit PCM) playback through an I2S codec described by BoardConfig::ACTIVE.audio. Ships an ES8388-compatible control driver (Murphy M3). Playback runs in its own FreeRTOS task and can loop until stopped. Includes AudioPlaylist, a chapter/track queue that auto-advances through a caller-supplied WavSource sequence for audiobook playback. Optional MP3 playback (playMp3()) via -DFREEINK_MP3_HELIX=1 plus a libhelix-mp3 lib_dep.
notes: When FREEINK_MP3_HELIX is defined, add a libhelix-mp3 source library to the consuming project's lib_deps — a port of the classic Helix fixed-point MP3 decoder's mp3dec.h C API (bundled by, e.g., ESP8266Audio and its forks).
